status: M3 removes communication-window GEMM padding and fixes role register allocation. M4 reduces first-GEMM blocking with static readiness ordering. Final EP16 cycle improves 4.9%/6.6% over b151d93, but is only 1.9%/0.1% faster than old PF: no claimed substantial 20K lead. M5 bounded GEMM autotune retains native parameters. M6 restricts native device GIN to GDAKI; paired performance is broadly unchanged, return helper spill is removed but main retains scalar spills.
